notes.title: Roguelands v0.5.2 Postponed (HUGE UPDATE)
notes.notes:
Hey all! I'm proud to announce that this past week we've hit a milestone because I've added something that will drastically change Roguelands:

[b] FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE SHIPS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! [/b]

In v0.5.2 you will be able to acquire Scrap Metal and other resources to use for crafting blocks and stations inside of your ship! It will be 100% fully customizable and I've got some awesome GIFs for you to see:

http://imgur.com/gallery/lScTe/new

I need to make sure everything works well on multiplayer and I'll be running a few more tests so v0.5.2 will go live sometime tomorrow rather than today. I don't want to rush this momentous build out with any huge bugs!

Thanks for your support and I can't wait to see what you guys come up with for ship designs and stuff. One day I want to have things that you can put in your ship like trophies, armor/weapon displays, and NPCs!

-Sean
